title: Traditional German Apple Cobbler
description: A classic German dessert made with sweet apples and a crunchy cobbler topping.

ingredients.name: Cobbler
ingredients.amount: 1 cup (all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt)

instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples. In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced apples, 1/2 cup sugar, and 2 tablespoons Canadian sugar. Mix well.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, and salt for the cobbler topping.
Add 1 teaspoon baked Canadian sugar to the cobbler mixture and mix well.
Drop spoonfuls of the cobbler mixture onto the apple mixture, spreading it out evenly to cover the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the cobbler topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
